validated_properties: Conditional multinomial logit recovers a strong positive performance preference in simulated choices.
Estimated performance coefficient remains near zero when synthetic choices are generated independently of performance.
A 999-draw synthetic permutation test detects a strong simulated performance effect.
All candidate rows in the same performance year share the same colony-label permutation within a replicate.
Permutation changes only performance labels; chosen outcomes, candidate sets, natal indicators and size controls remain fixed.
Events with multiple chosen alternatives are rejected.
Events with fewer than two candidates are rejected.
Row-level performance values must exactly match the frozen year-by-colony performance table.
